249575101_3578d276.text: .These long-range inhibitory connections differentiate the PHb from the dLGN, which only contains local inhibitory networks (Morgan et al., 2019).

249575101_415f9595.text: Unlike the majority of the dorsal thalamus in mice, the retino-recipient dorsal lateral geniculate nucleus (dLGN) contains a subset of inhibitory (GABAergic) interneurons that spatially and temporally synchronize local networks (15)(Halassa et al., 2019)(Sherman, 2004)

249575101_cb3f6032.text: PHb GABA neurons, which are defined by the coexpression of Vgat, Gad1, and Gad2, do not express parvalbumin or somatostatin, classic markers of TRN neurons (Li et al., 2020)(256823087), or nNOS, previously shown to delineate a subpopulation of dLGN interneurons (Leist et al., 2016).

249575101_ea195978.text: Excitatory-relay neurons were identified by Slc17a6 (Vglut2) expression, which is found in excitatory neurons in subcortical structures, including the thalamus (Mestikawy et al., 2011). In situ hybridization assays revealed that excitatory-relay neurons are homogeneously distributed throughout the dorsal thalamus and represent ~74% of neurons that constitute the PHb (Fig. 1, A to C).
